revision_note: The profiler was built while the production changes were uncommitted on the base revision. Those production sources were subsequently committed as measured_source_commit.

metric_notes.process_times: Wall/CPU/RSS values cover the entire invocation, including parsing, elaboration, output, profiling snapshots and any enabled update probes. They are recorded only on the initial phase row.
metric_notes.close_ns: Instrumented close() time; excludes Rust compilation and elaboration.
metric_notes.exclusive_costs: Categories are disjoint exclusive timer totals and sum exactly to close_ns for each phase.
metric_notes.graph_preparations: Cache preparation calls, including hits; not a graph reconstruction count.
metric_notes.primary_edge_visits: Selected primary propagation calls; wrapper calls are excluded. Historical instrumentation counted wrappers as well.
metric_notes.normalization_stratum_calls: Calls of generated stratum 5, containing the functionality normalization barrier.
metric_notes.consumer_stratum_calls: Calls of generated stratum 6, containing the remaining main recursive rule groups.
metric_notes.candidate_counts: Transport batches and changed-input counts measure attempted work, not unique new facts.
metric_notes.canonical_counts: Counts concern canonical type element sets after initial closure. Update probes do not dump per-phase table snapshots.
metric_notes.equality_representatives: Scheduling can change representative IDs; raw tuple hashes are not semantic equality checks across revisions.
